# unifi_access_door (Resource)

Configures an existing UniFi Access door (`/proxy/access/api/v2/locations/door/{id}`). Doors are **discovered**, not created — this resource is update/import-only: it adopts an existing door by `door_id` and manages its name, floor, and type; destroying it stops managing the door without deleting it. **Modeled from the reverse-engineered Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `door_id` (String) The discovered door's `unique_id`. Changing it targets a different door (forces replacement).

### Optional

- `extra_type` (String) Door type tag (e.g. `standard`).
- `floor_name` (String) Move the door under the floor with this name. This is a write-time association; the door object does not echo its floor name, so it is not reconciled on refresh (no drift detection) — HIL-unverified.
- `name` (String) Door display name.

### Read-Only

- `dps_connected` (Boolean) Whether a door-position sensor is connected (read-only, live state).
- `full_name` (String) Full location path of the door (read-only).
- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`); equals `door_id`.
- `is_open` (Boolean) Whether the door is currently open (read-only, live state).
- `location_type` (String) Location type of the door (read-only).
- `timezone` (String) Door timezone (read-only).
